title: Storage boundary — spoken follow-up
situation: In a technical discussion, an architect asks why files are outside the relational database. You must answer aloud accurately without overstating the evidence.
instructions: Deliver a sixty-second answer with decision, evidence, limitation and one clarifying question.

vocabulary.meaning: the precise concept required for storage boundary
an observation supported by a reproducible check

expectedElements: A clear decision tied to the scenario
Verified evidence and one explicit limitation
modelAnswer: My decision is that The database keeps transactional metadata and the object store keeps file content; an opaque reference connects them. The current evidence is limited to the documented checks, so I would not claim more. Which constraint or observation would make us revisit this decision?
commonMistakes: Using confident adjectives without naming evidence or a limitation
variants: Answer again after the reviewer changes one cost or security constraint.
